subject: Marketplace publishing: brand, trademark, and support-window playbook for CloudBridge
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin@cloudbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudBridge Partnerships <partnerships@cloudbridge.com>
Date: 2027-04-25 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace publishing: brand, trademark, and support-window playbook for CloudBridge

Hi Jordan / Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick chat this morning. As we get our AWS/GCP/Azure listings ready I'd like to lock down three things we need from Redwood to satisfy the marketplaces and our channel team:

1) Branding and allowed copy — AWS team flagged a couple phrases that mention enterprise-grade SLAs; we need the canonical short description (<= 250 chars), long description, and a list of approved trademarks/logos you want to appear.

2) Support window & routing — CloudBridge needs clarity on your support hours for marketplace customers (business hours vs 24x7), plus the routing rules for co-sell leads (who owns initial triage, escalation path, and contact points for emergency P1s).

3) Evidence for policy review — trademark clearance note, SOC 2 statement reference, and any published SLA doc we can link to in the marketplace listing.

I've attached our draft marketplace checklist and a matrix with the current slots we expect for publication (attachments: marketplace_brand_guidelines.pdf, support_window_matrix.xlsx). Can you take a look and confirm what Redwood can commit to for the public listing? We have an internal co-sell sync on Tuesday and would like to close this by EOD Monday if possible.

Appreciate it —
Erin
Erin Walsh
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge Inc.
--
attachments: marketplace_brand_guidelines.pdf (pdf), support_window_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace publishing: brand, trademark, and support-window playbook for CloudBridge

Erin — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Looping in Laura from Legal and Karthik from Product to confirm the pieces below.

Quick notes from my side:
- We can provide a 250-char short description and a longer marketing description; Karthik Iyer will propose edited copy by EOD today.
- For listings, we publish a link to our public SLA, and we can provide a SOC 2 Type II attestation date and a redacted report on request (Legal will confirm what we can attach).
- Support routing: we currently offer 24x5 standard coverage for hosted marketplace customers with 24x7 P1 escalation on Dedicated/Enterprise plans. That said, for co-sell listings we can commit to a documented routing flow and named escalation contacts.

Laura — can Legal confirm what trademark files we can share (logos + trademark clearance notes)? Karthik — can you review the proposed short/long copy and the support matrix Erin attached and flag any product constraints?

Jordan Blake
Senior GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference

On Apr 25, 2027, at 09:12 AM, Erin Walsh <erin@cloudbridge.com> wrote:
> Hi Jordan / Karthik,
> 
> Thanks again for the quick chat this morning...
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace publishing: brand, trademark, and support-window playbook for CloudBridge

Erin — added a few concrete edits after reviewing the attachments. See inline summary and attached notes (trademark_clearance_notes.docx).

Key product/legal decisions we can commit to for the marketplace listing:
- Copy: Proposed short description (<=250 chars): "Redwood Inference — low-latency LLM inference platform with predictable pricing and unified deployment for hosted, dedicated, and private environments."
- Long description: I'll paste the polished 1-paragraph long form in the shared Drive (link below) — we trimmed any absolute claims (e.g., \"industry-leading\") to avoid policy flags.
- Trademarks/logos: Legal OK to share vector logo (color + mono) and the trademark text file; we cannot include third-party logos on our listing without partner permission. Laura, confirm if any additional clearance notes required.
- Support windows & routing: For marketplace-published plans we will list standard support as 24x5 with documented P1 escalation available 24x7 for customers on committed Dedicated plans. For joint co-sell leads we propose the following routing: 
  * Initial inbound marketplace lead -> CloudBridge SDR (owned by CloudBridge)
  * Technical triage -> Redwood Solutions Engineer (on the opportunity)
  * If P1 suspected -> immediate escalation to Redwood Incident Lead (on-call) and CloudBridge success lead

Action items:
- Jordan: confirm the public short/long copy by EOD tonight
- Laura: post any limitations on attachments in the trademark doc
- Erin / CloudBridge: confirm you're ok with Redwood listing 24x5 + named P1 escalation for marketplace customers; if you need explicit 24x7 support in the public listing we will need to scope a support add-on and update pricing.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCloudBridge-Listing

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Marketing | Redwood Inference

On Apr 25, 2027, at 10:03 AM, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Erin — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments...
From: Erin Walsh <erin@cloudbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@cloudbridge.com>
Date: 2027-04-26 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace publishing: brand, trademark, and support-window playbook for CloudBridge

Jordan / Karthik / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and the proposed language. CloudBridge is comfortable with the short description and the published support wording of 24x5 + 24x7 P1 escalation for Dedicated customers — that fits our internal expectations.

Two small asks before we publish:
1) Can Redwood add a single-sentence "support expectations" bullet in the marketplace listing that links to the Drive support matrix so customers know how to reach on-call for P1s (we can host the link on our side if preferred).
2) We need a signed acknowledgement from Legal that the trademark files are cleared for use in the marketplaces (we'll accept a brief email confirmation or a stamped PDF).

If you can provide both by EOD Tuesday we can lock our co-sell kickoff on Wednesday and submit to AWS/GCP/Azure for publication next week. I'll also send the DocuSign for the partnership addendum today (link: https://www.docusign.com/CB-2027-014/contract).

Thanks —
Erin
